probes.procedure: Address every node directly, confirm its declared AlmaLinux 9 or Alpine role, obtain a successful HTTP response from / on TCP 6700, and corroborate that the listener is provided by an active distribution-supported Nginx service.

Inspect failed units, duplicate or conflicting web servers, HAProxy installation, stale Nginx configuration copies, debug processes, and executor-created temporary residue while accepting distribution-specific service layouts.

assertions.pass_condition: Node1 is AlmaLinux 9 and its active Nginx service returns a successful HTTP response at / on TCP 6700.
assertions.fail_condition: Node1 is confirmed to have the wrong role, inactive Nginx, or a reachable TCP-6700 endpoint that does not return successful HTTP.

assertions.pass_condition: Node2 is AlmaLinux 9 and its active Nginx service returns a successful HTTP response at / on TCP 6700.
assertions.fail_condition: Node2 is confirmed to have the wrong role, inactive Nginx, or a reachable TCP-6700 endpoint that does not return successful HTTP.

assertions.pass_condition: Node3 is Alpine and its active Nginx service returns a successful HTTP response at / on TCP 6700.
assertions.fail_condition: Node3 is confirmed to have the wrong role, inactive Nginx, or a reachable TCP-6700 endpoint that does not return successful HTTP.

assertions.pass_condition: Node4 is Alpine and its active Nginx service returns a successful HTTP response at / on TCP 6700.
assertions.fail_condition: Node4 is confirmed to have the wrong role, inactive Nginx, or a reachable TCP-6700 endpoint that does not return successful HTTP.

assertions.pass_condition: Each node retains only its role-appropriate Nginx service, configuration, content, logs, and necessary distribution tooling.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete executor-created HAProxy, duplicate web service, failed unit, debug process, stale configuration, or temporary residue remains.
